description: Build a day-by-day math study plan for one exam (grade) up to the exam date from the learner's current mastery: daily practice weighted to weak topics, review of missed problems, timed sets and rest days. Uses the exam date saved in WaterExamMath for that grade (save_study_settings saves one); pass examDate (YYYY-MM-DD) to plan for a different date. The date passed here is not saved. Read-only; changes nothing.

exam.description: Exam (grade) id, e.g. "ca-d2" or "ca-t1". Leave out to use the grade the user saved (save_study_settings); get_exam_overview lists the ids.

examDate.description: Exam date as YYYY-MM-DD, if the user gives one

name: get_study_plan
title: Get study plan
